svg.text: 桌面设备：ESP32-S3 + OLED + 触摸键

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 图例：11 根导线（线号 = 搭建顺序）

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 3V3 → 电源轨 · red · bb.b24 → bb.top_inner_19 · 7.6 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: GND → 电源轨 · black · bb.b3 → bb.top_outer_2 · 12.7 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: + 轨跨段跳线 · red · bb.top_inner_25 → bb.top_inner_26 · 5.1 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: − 轨跨段跳线 · black · bb.top_outer_25 → bb.top_outer_26 · 5.1 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: OLED VCC · red · bb.i41 → bb.top_inner_33 · 30.5 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: OLED GND · black · bb.i40 → bb.top_outer_33 · 35.6 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: SDA GPIO8 → OLED · blue · bb.a13 → bb.h43 · 99.1 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: SCL GPIO9 → OLED · yellow · bb.b10 → bb.h42 · 101.6 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 触摸 VCC · red · bb.b50 → bb.top_inner_41 · 10.2 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 触摸 GND · black · bb.b52 → bb.top_outer_42 · 10.2 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 触摸 IO → GPIO4 · green · bb.b51 → bb.b21 · 76.2 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 走线长度为图上折线估算，不含插入深度、弯折与连接器余量。
